item.title: ‘Once upon a career’ promotes big dreams at annual SOCSD Possibility Fest
item.description: Starkville-Oktibbeha Consolidated School District’s Discovery Center hosted more than 35 families this month from across the community and their children for the annual Possibility Fest, a fun and engaging opportunity for preschoolers to experience hands-on activities and early career exploration. For this year’s event, Discovery Center partnered with more than 30 area organizations to help attending families connect with resources, information and valuable community support. item.title: Ole Miss falls at South Carolina, loses second in a row
item.description: No. 3 South Carolina held No. 17 Ole Miss to just 26.5% shooting from the field Sunday afternoon, and the Gamecocks defeated the Rebels 85-48 in Columbia, South Carolina. The post Ole Miss falls at South Carolina, loses second in a row appeared first on The Dispatch.

item.title: Judge blocks release of special counsel Jack Smith’s report on Trump classified documents case
item.description: A federal judge on Monday permanently barred the release of a report by special counsel Jack Smith on his investigation into President Donald Trump’s hoarding of classified documents, a prosecution that was once seen as the most perilous of the four criminal cases the Republican faced. The post Judge blocks release of special counsel Jack Smith’s report on Trump classified documents case appeared first on The Dispatch.
